purpose: Verify final BLACK single-instance runtime, repaired amx systemd user session, and Windows Startup launcher after repair.
command:
set -e
sleep 3
echo '===BLACK_SYSTEM_SERVICE==='
systemctl is-enabled amx-black.service
systemctl is-active amx-black.service
systemctl show amx-black.service -p User -p MainPID -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager
echo '===AMX_USER_SESSION==='
loginctl show-user amx -p State -p Linger -p RuntimePath -p Sessions
systemctl is-active user@1000.service
echo '===BLACK_PROCESS_COUNT==='
COUNT=$(ps -eo args | grep '/home/amx/amx-black/BLACK/worker.py' | grep -v grep | wc -l)
echo "count=$COUNT"
[ "$COUNT" -eq 1 ]
echo '===WINDOWS_STARTUP==='
test -f '/mnt/c/Users/eztra/AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup/AMX-BLACK-WSL.cmd'
cat '/mnt/c/Users/eztra/AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup/AMX-BLACK-WSL.cmd'
echo '===LEGACY_USER_UNIT==='
test ! -e "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/amx-black.service"
test ! -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/amx-black.service"
echo '===PASS==='
echo BLACK_FINAL_VERIFY_PASS
